suggestion.cause: All database connections are in use, so new requests wait and then time out.
suggestion.fix: Find connections that are not released (missing close / context manager), then raise the pool size or the database max_connections if load really grew. Add a timeout and retry when getting a connection.
suggestion.immediate: Restart the affected service instances to release stuck connections, and temporarily raise the pool size / max_connections.
